sources.entry: LittleLink - Simplistic approach for links in bio with 100+ branded buttons (alternative to Linktree). (Demo, Source Code) MIT Javascript

summary.one_liner: LittleLink is a self-hosted, vanilla HTML/CSS "links in bio" page that serves as a DIY alternative to Linktree, with 100+ branded button styles.
summary.what_it_does: LittleLink is a static single-page links-in-bio site built from plain HTML, CSS and no build tooling. It ships with more than 100 branded button styles for popular services, and the README says more are added by the community. It offers auto, light and dark themes that can be set in index.html and customized in style.css. Buttons with low contrast against the background get an inverse outline to stay visible. The README also describes a Button Builder that previews button styles and generates CSS for css/brands.css and HTML for index.html, with contrast checks. A Docker Compose setup is included for running the site in a container.
use_cases: deploy a static bio page on GitHub Pages
host a simple link page on a home lab server
notable: More than 100 branded button styles, extensible by community contributions
No build step: no gulp, npm or framework required
Button Builder that generates CSS and HTML and checks contrast ratios
One-click deploy buttons for Cloudflare, DigitalOcean, Vercel, Netlify and Amplify
Auto, light and dark themes with inverse outline for low-contrast buttons
caveats: The README notes some branded buttons may fall short of optimal contrast accessibility
Editing requires basic HTML knowledge, and custom buttons are added by hand in CSS and HTML
Analytics recommendation links to Fathom via a referral link
